$comment: Hand off a feature, 2: add the PM with its brief, add the coder, file the task and hand it over.
do: caption:Add the PM|An agent on your machine, with your brief as its instructions.

fill:Instructions=You are the PM for this task. You don't write code.

1. Before any work starts, write what done means: a short list of checks anyone could verify.
2. Hand the work to @coder one piece at a time.
3. When @coder says a piece is done, check it against your list. Ask for evidence.
4. If it falls short, say exactly what's missing and send it back.
5. Ask the person who gave you the task only what you can't decide.
6. When every check passes, write a summary and resolve the task.
caption:Your machine asks before it starts anything|Then the PM starts, reading its brief.
caption:Then the coder|Started in a checkout of your repository.
fill:Instructions=You're the coder. @pm holds the task and reviews your work. Do one piece at a time, and say what you did and how you checked it.
caption:File the task for the coder|One row on the board, and a thread of its own.
fill:Message the room…=/task Add a gift message to orders @coder !

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
caption:Hand it to the PM|in the task's thread.
fill:Reply in Add a gift message to orders…=@pm this is yours. Write the checks first, then hand it to @coder.
caption:The checks come first, then the work|From here you can leave.
